pages.text: Left-click a curved pipe to break it, in any mode. The middle button turns the grid: off, axial, outer or inner corners, outer or inner edges; sneak to turn it back. Hold Ctrl to place freely.

Hold $(k:flowline.options)$() and scroll for the option wheel: Remove, Branch, Extend, Move, Force joint and Settings. Let go to use it on the node or curve you look at.$(br2)Dye a curved pipe like a block pipe: other colours do not connect.
